{"reason": "All 8 shown misses are demand-forecast-error rows v1 left unknown: 5 have market-mismatch=#t with no bias flag, 3 have forecast-bias with bias-amount 0.065-0.081 under the 0.1 cutoff. Broaden the forecast branch to accept market-signal-mismatch and lower the bias threshold to 0.06, recovering ~1.4M without touching supplier-delay rules.", "source": "(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((or (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event)
         (and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
              (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.06)))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
